entities.summary: Michael George Moye is an American photographer and a former television writer and producer. In his television career he has written for shows such as The Jeffersons, Diff'rent Strokes, Good Times, and 227, and produced It's Your Move and The Jeffersons. His best-known work is the 1987 series Married... with Children, created with Ron Leavitt for the then-fledgling Fox network.
